headline: Haindava 27 November ko theatres mein
title: Haindava Release 27 November | Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas | Movie News Hindi
video_script: Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas की pan-Indian occult thriller Haindava 27 November 2026 को theatres में आ रही है. इसे Ludheer Byreddy ने directed किया है. Samyuktha female lead में हैं और Mahesh Manjrekar एक temple priest बने हैं. Sai Sreenivas एक atheist police officer का role कर रहे हैं. आप देखोगे? Comment करो!
description: Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas starrer occult thriller Haindava 27 November 2026 ko release hogi. Director Ludheer Byreddy, cast mein Samyuktha aur Mahesh Manjrekar. Sources: Telangana Today, B4U Entertainment.
joke: Atheist police wala hero aur occult thriller, ye combination toh sach mein daravna hai.
